Government of Maharashtra

Martyr Rajguru Chowk, Madam Cama Marg,
Mantralaya, Mumbai 400032

Preamble: My Vasundhara Abhiyan 4. The procedure for the award of cash prizes to the winning local bodies in the 12 categories of the award has been notified vide Government Decision dated 27.09.2024 at Reference No. (1). Accordingly, a Detailed Project Report of the works to be taken up by the local bodies out of the award amount has been prepared vide Government Decision dated 08.02.2022 at Reference No. Administrative approval has to be obtained from a committee constituted under the chairmanship of Secretary, Department of Environment and Climate Change.

2. Accordingly, for grant of administrative approval to the Detailed Project Report received from the Awardee Local Bodies, Ms. The Committee has made recommendations after discussing the Detailed Project Report submitted by the Local Bodies in its meeting held on 07.04.2026 under the Chairmanship of Secretary, Department of Environment & Climate Change. The government was considering granting administrative approval to the detailed project report of the respective local bodies as recommended by the committee.

Government Decision: Taking into account the points mentioned in the Preamble, under the My Vasundhara Abhiyan 4.0, the total number of block-wise second rank to be received by the Ghatnandre Gram Panchayat is Rs. 15.00 The focus will be on the works to be undertaken out of the prize money of Rs. The Detailed Project Report costing Rs.15,08, 764.00 (Rupees fifteen lakhs eight thousand seven hundred and sixty four only) has been submitted by the Gram Panchayat Officer, Ghatnandre Gram Panchayat with the technical approval of the Executive Engineer, Sangli Zilla Parishad. The proposal was submitted by the Ghatnandre Gram Panchayat. The Committee constituted under the Chairmanship of Secretary, Department of Environment & Climate Change was considered in its meetings held on 07.04.2026. Considering the recommendation of the committee constituted under the chairmanship of Hon'ble Secretary, Department of Environment and Climate Change, the total amount submitted by Ghatnandre Gram Panchayat is Rs. The works in the Detailed Project Report costing Rs.13,06, 254.00 (Rupees Thirteen Lakhs Six Thousand Two Hundred and Fifty Only) are being accorded administrative sanction by the Government subject to the following conditions and conditions. The works for which administrative sanction is being granted are shown in the accompanying Annexure-9.

2. The Committee may, for administrative approval, deduct Rs. 02, 509.00 Appropriation of the amount The Ghatnandre Gram Panchayat should prepare a revised Detailed Project Report for green area augmentation and other environment friendly works and submit it again to the Government for administrative approval with the technical approval of the Executive Engineer of the Zilla Parishad.
3. Terms and Conditions
1) The implementation mechanism for the works in this Detailed Project Report shall be the Ghatnandre Gram Panchayat.

2) The financial and physical progress report of the implementation of the works mentioned in this Detailed Project Report should be sent to my Vasundhara Mission Directorate by the 5th of every month.
3) The implementation of the works in this Detailed Project Report should be completed within the next 6 months from the approval of the Administrator.
4) Expenditure in excess of the prize money should be made out of self-funding.
5) In case of any increase in the original project cost in this Detailed Project Report for any reason, no additional funds / grants will be made available for the same.

4. The Ghatnandre Gram Panchayat has been awarded the second position at the divisional level in the "Gram Panchayat Group (population of 25000-5000)" category in the My Vasundhara Abhiyan 4.0. A prize of ₹1 lakh has been received.
Of this, 50 per cent is Rs. An amount of ₹7.50 lakh has been disbursed to them.
